displayPattern: Outdoor control display reads 04 (ASXC/DSXC/GSXC AC and ASZC/DSZC/GSZC heat pump outdoor units with the integrated control module)
meaning: Locked rotor: the compressor is not turning properly.
causes: Low line voltage or wiring problem
diySteps: Technician: confirm high voltage to the system is within specification, check the run capacitor and replace it if bad, and check wiring
Technician: check compressor operation and repair or replace as needed
safetyNote: Outdoor units carry line voltage even when the thermostat is off. Switch off the unit's disconnect and breaker before touching anything. Refrigerant, wiring, compressor and control-board work must be done by a licensed HVAC technician.
proAdvice: Call a licensed HVAC technician: do not keep resetting the breaker, since a locked rotor stresses the compressor.
sourceTitle: Service and Troubleshooting: ASXC/DSXC/GSXC condensing units and ASZC/DSZC/GSZC heat pumps (RS6200007 r27, hosted by Daikin Comfort)
